controls: Do not merge the supplemental records into atomic-requirements.v1.json until every mapped candidate is compared against the full canonical ledger.
Do not count a mapped supplemental record as a net-new requirement unless the canonical ledger lacks an equivalent atomic statement.
Where one existing candidate combines multiple obligations, retain child requirements only if the final ledger explicitly records the split and links the parent candidate.
No candidate or requirement in this crosswalk is independently approved, implementation-mapped or test-executed.
